name: Mornine (M1)
summary: A humanoid from carmaker Chery's robotics arm, first put to work as showroom sales staff in its own dealerships before going on general sale online. It runs a dual-model stack — Chery's own CheryGPT alongside DeepSeek — holds conversation in ten languages, opens car doors autonomously and can be driven by VR teleoperation.
notable: Deployed as dealership sales staff before consumer sale
